# Understanding transfer fees and timing


nsave team


Nov 22, 2025


Transfer timing depends on the destination, currency and receiving network. Review the quoted fee and delivery estimate before confirming.


## Example transfer comparison


Transfer type Typical delivery Example fee


Everyday transfers


Internal transfer Instant Free


Local bank transfer Minutes to one business day Shown before confirmation


International routes


International wire One to three business days Varies by route


Example monthly total Four transfers $12.00


### What each transfer status means


- Pending: nsave has received the instruction and is completing its checks.
- Processing: the transfer is moving through the payment network.
- Completed: the receiving institution has accepted the transfer.


#### When a transfer takes longer


Weekends, public holidays, recipient details and extra compliance checks can all affect an estimate. The in-app tracker shows the latest available status.
